title: Kubernetes Service Compiler
description: Compiles Kubernetes Service manifests. Enforces: selector resolves to a workload, each service port maps to a container port, service type is in the allowed set, no duplicate port names.

error_codes.KS001: k8s-service-spec.json missing or invalid — required: name, selector, ports[]
error_codes.KS002: Selector does not resolve to any declared workload label set
error_codes.KS003: Service port maps to a container port that does not exist
error_codes.KS004: Duplicate port name or number within the same Service
error_codes.KS005: Service type not in allowed set for the target environment
